name: music-library-tagger
description: Clean up an artist's MP3/ID3 album collection for Navidrome, Plex, Jellyfin or Subsonic: canonical album titles, correct release years, track titles, genres, multi-disc numbering, album artist and cover art (embedded + cover.jpg), verified against MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive. Analyzes, asks a few decisions, writes a reviewable Markdown plan, applies it reversibly with a full tag backup.
